title: Examples / Displays

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Preserve source clarity at physical scale so visitors can identify the host while noticing supporting organizations.
strategic_value: A partner-led display system can make IBM visible without competing with the event or booth owner.
demonstration: A wide welcome sign with a viewer silhouette and partner-logo grid is compared with a narrow roll-up banner.
practical_value: Adjust acknowledgement density and placement to the display format and expected viewing distance.

content_islands.name: Welcome signage
content_islands.spec: Place the wide display at left, with partner branding and message separated from the supporting-logo grid; include the human silhouette for scale.

content_islands.name: Booth banner
content_islands.spec: Place the vertical roll-up at right with partner identity above a small IBM acknowledgement and a larger lower content field.

reference_purposes.Application: The page applies the hierarchy to a welcome sign and roll-up banner, including a human-scale reference.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The layouts are explicitly examples and do not prescribe all permitted display arrangements.
